news.title: Springville fills vacant District 4 council seat
news.summary: City Council selected Kevin Early for its vacant District 4 seat at the November 16 meeting. The council also approved a neighborhood paving agreement.
body: At its November 16 meeting, the Springville City Council selected Kevin Early to fill its vacant District 4 seat after interviewing three applicants.
The council also approved paving work in the Crandall Crest neighborhood, with an agreement for the neighborhood HOA to reimburse the city for the expense.
Early was expected to be sworn in at the first December council meeting. Confirm upcoming meeting dates and times with the City of Springville.

news.title: Springville seeks input on its future
news.summary: The city is gathering feedback for a comprehensive plan covering growth, quality of life, and local improvements. Residents and others with ties to the city can weigh in.
body: Springville is seeking feedback from residents, workers, property and business owners, and families whose children attend school in the city as it prepares its comprehensive plan.
The survey asks about quality of life, local improvements, and how Springville might grow in the next five to fifteen years.
Find survey details and eligibility information in the original reporting.

news.title: How to follow Springville City Council
news.summary: Find meeting notices, minutes and recordings on the City of Springville’s official website. Check before attending for changes or special meetings.
body: The City of Springville posts information about City Council meetings, minutes, and recordings on its official website.
Regular meetings are listed for the first and third Monday of each month at 6 p.m. Work sessions, public hearings, and special meetings may follow a different schedule.
Before attending, check the official meeting page for the latest notice, time, and location.
